lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's twenty? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 20? Nope!

lines.text: The area is sixty. D is the midpoint of B C, and A E to E C is two to one.
lines.caption: The area is 60. D is the midpoint of BC, and AE to EC is 2 to 1.

lines.text: What's the area of triangle A B P?
lines.caption: What's the area of triangle ABP?

lines.text: A B D is half of sixty. That's thirty.
lines.caption: ABD is half of 60. That's 30.

lines.text: Draw D F, parallel to B E. F is the midpoint of E C.
lines.caption: Draw DF, parallel to BE. F is the midpoint of EC.

lines.text: Along A C, A E is four steps, and E F is one.
lines.caption: Along AC, AE is 4 steps, and EF is 1.

lines.text: So A P to P D is four to one.
lines.caption: So AP to PD is 4 to 1.

lines.text: Four fifths of thirty is twenty-four!
lines.caption: 4/5 of 30 is 24!

lines.text: Twenty was the trap. Two to one is for A C.
lines.caption: 20 was the trap. 2 to 1 is for AC.

lines.text: Did you get twenty-four? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 24? Tell me below!
